This is not dangerous but is a mismatch between advertised capability and actual implementation.

llm.guidance: This skill runs a bundled Python script that generates simulated tracking timelines locally — it does not call carrier APIs or send data out, and it requires no credentials. However, its description overstates capability (claims 100+ carriers and live tracking while the code supports only a few carriers and returns demo data). If you need real, live tracking, this skill will not be sufficient without wiring in official carrier APIs (which would require API keys). Also note the source/homepage are unknown; if you plan to use this in production or install system-wide, verify the author or obtain a version from a trusted source. Finally, SKILL.md shows a 'track' command but the bundled file is track.py — ensure how the CLI is exposed in your environment before relying on it.
